_comment: Rewrite rules for the static site, in Render's semantics (docs: render.com/docs/redirects-rewrites): a file that exists is served first; otherwise the FIRST matching rule applies. Dynamic pages are built once for the placeholder id '_' (see src/lib/route-id.ts) and the host serves that file for every real id. render.yaml must carry the same rules, in the same order (a backend test checks it). The /api rule is added separately because its destination is the backend's address.
